post.summary: Creates a prospect scan for a known Google Business Profile.
post.description:
The service assigns the scan's resource name and begins processing. A
successful response normally has PENDING or RUNNING state; it does not
imply that results are available.

For a Google Business Profile target, the caller supplies only the CID. The
server resolves the profile, including the business identity and location,
and derives the search keyword from the profile's primary category.

Only one prospect scan may be created for the same Google Business Profile
CID in an account within a 60-minute period. Additional create requests
during that period return ALREADY_EXISTS. The status includes a
google.rpc.ResourceInfo detail with resource_type
"api.yextapis.com/ProspectScan" and resource_name set to the existing
scan's full resource name.

Possible errors include:

* INVALID_ARGUMENT when the CID is malformed.
* ALREADY_EXISTS when a scan was created for the same CID in the account
  within the previous 60 minutes.
* NOT_FOUND when the CID does not resolve to an accessible profile.
* FAILED_PRECONDITION when the resolved profile lacks information required
  to run the scan, such as a usable primary category or location.
* RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when an account or service quota is exceeded.

requestBody.description:
The prospect scan to create.

Set target to identify the business to scan. The remaining fields are
assigned by the service.

get.summary: Gets the current state and metadata of a prospect scan.
get.description: Returns NOT_FOUND when the scan does not exist or is not accessible.

get.summary: Fetches competitors discovered in local search results for a completed scan.
get.description:
Use this method to build a business-centric list of the competitors found
by the scan. Each discovered prospect includes its observed search rank,
available business profile details, and calculated metrics. The scan target
is not included. To inspect the search results and other source material
used to produce this result set, use FetchProspectScanEvidence.

Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION while the scan is not in SUCCEEDED state.
Returns NOT_FOUND when the scan does not exist or is not accessible.

get.summary: Fetches supporting evidence collected for a completed prospect scan.
get.description:
Use this method to inspect the source material used to produce the scan's
summarized results and discovered prospects. Evidence is source-centric and
includes search results, AI answers and citations, and publisher listing
checks. To retrieve a business-centric list of competitors, use
FetchDiscoveredProspects.

Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION while the scan is not in SUCCEEDED state.
Returns NOT_FOUND when the scan does not exist or is not accessible.

get.summary: Fetches the summarized results of a completed prospect scan.
get.description:
Returns FAILED_PRECONDITION while the scan is not in SUCCEEDED state.
Returns NOT_FOUND when the scan does not exist or is not accessible.

prospectRank.description: The prospect's one-based rank, or absent when it was not ranked.

competitors.description: Ranked competitors, ordered by rank ascending.

v1AiCompetitorRanking.description: Prospect and competitor rankings in an AI experience.

prompt.description: The prompt used to evaluate the prospect and its market.

answer.description: The answer returned by the AI experience.

mentions.description: Businesses mentioned in the answer, in observed order.

v1AiEvidence.description: Evidence collected from an AI-generated answer.

id.description: A stable identifier for the experience. Treat this value as opaque.

displayName.description: The current public display name of the experience.

modelVersion.description: The underlying model version, when the provider exposes it.

v1AiExperience.description: An AI product or answer experience included in the scan.

rank.description: The one-based rank, or absent when the prospect was not ranked.

visibilityPercent.description: The percentage of relevant answers in which the prospect was mentioned.

v1AiExperiencePerformance.description: The prospect's performance in an AI experience.

prospectValue.description: The value calculated for the prospect, when available.

benchmarkValue.description: The benchmark value for comparable businesses, when available.

v1BenchmarkComparison.description: Compares one metric between the prospect and a benchmark.

title.description: The source title, when supplied by the AI experience.

v1Citation.description: A source cited by an AI-generated answer.

searchRank.description: The business's one-based rank in the local search results.

metrics.description: Metric values calculated for the discovered business.

v1DiscoveredProspect.description: A business discovered in the local search results for a prospect scan.

discoveredProspects.description: Prospects ordered by search rank ascending.

comparisons.description: Comparisons between the prospect and relevant benchmarks.

aiRankings.description: Rankings and mentions observed in supported AI experiences.

generatedTime.description: The time at which these results were finalized.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, in the inclusive range [-90, 90].

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, in the inclusive range [-180, 180].

v1GeoPoint.description: A geographic point in WGS84 coordinates.

publisher.description: The public display name of the publisher.

listingUri.description: The URI of the matched listing, when available.

publisherId.description: The public API identifier for the publisher, when available.

v1ListingResult.description: A listing observed on one publisher.

v1ListingStatus.description:
The outcome of matching a business to a publisher listing.

 - LISTING_STATUS_MATCHED: A listing was found and its material business facts matched.
 - LISTING_STATUS_MISMATCHED: A listing was found but one or more material business facts differed.
 - LISTING_STATUS_NOT_FOUND: No listing was found.

v1Metric.description:
Metric types returned by prospect scans.

 - METRIC_SEARCH_RANK: One-based rank in local search results. Lower values are better.
 - METRIC_REVIEW_RATING: Average Google review rating.
 - METRIC_REVIEW_COUNT: Number of Google reviews.
 - METRIC_REVIEW_TOPIC_COUNT: Number of distinct topics found in Google reviews.
 - METRIC_LAST_REVIEW_AGE_DAYS: Days since the most recent Google review. Lower values are better.
 - METRIC_OWNER_REVIEW_RESPONSES_PAST_YEAR: Number of owner responses to Google reviews during the previous year.
 - METRIC_REVIEWS_WITH_TEXT_PAST_YEAR: Number of Google reviews with text during the previous year.
 - METRIC_AVERAGE_REVIEW_RESPONSE_TIME_DAYS: Average owner response time in days during the previous year.
 - METRIC_PHOTO_COUNT: Number of photos on the Google Business Profile.
 - METRIC_PROFILE_COMPLETION: Google Business Profile completion as a value from 0 to 1.
 - METRIC_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTES: Number of attributes on the Google Business Profile.
 - METRIC_LISTINGS_ACCURACY_PERCENT: Percentage of checked listings with matching material business facts.
 - METRIC_LISTINGS_VISIBILITY_PERCENT: Percentage of checked publishers on which a listing was found.

value.description: The metric value. Interpretation and scale are defined by metric.

v1MetricValue.description: A metric value produced by a prospect scan.

administrativeArea.description: The top-level administrative area, such as a state or province.

locality.description: The city, town, or other locality.

dependentLocality.description: The dependent locality, such as a neighborhood, when available.

addressLines.description: Unstructured street-address lines in display order.

v1PostalAddress.description: A postal address for a prospect.

googleBusinessProfileCid.description: The Google Business Profile CID, when the prospect was matched to a profile.

websiteUri.description: The canonical public website URI, when known.

phoneNumber.description: The public phone number reported by the business profile, when available.

primaryCategory.description: The profile's primary category in display form.

secondaryCategories.description: Additional profile categories in display form.

v1Prospect.description: Public business profile information for a prospect.

businessName.description: The business name extracted from the answer.

rank.description: The one-based rank when the answer explicitly ordered businesses.

v1ProspectMention.description: A business mention extracted from an AI-generated answer.

googleRank.description:
The prospect's one-based local Google rank for the derived keyword, when
the prospect appeared in the collected result set.

aiPerformance.description: The prospect's performance in each supported AI experience.

listingsAccuracyPercent.description:
The percentage of checked publisher listings whose material business facts
matched the prospect.

listingsVisibilityPercent.description: The percentage of checked publishers on which a listing was found.

v1ProspectPerformance.description: Summary performance values for a prospect.

name.description:
The resource name of the prospect scan.

Format: accounts/{account}/scout/prospectScans/{prospect_scan}

searchKeyword.description: The search keyword derived from the profile's primary category.

createTime.description: The time at which the scan was created.

updateTime.description: The time at which the scan last changed state or metadata.

v1ProspectScan.description: A fast assessment of a prospective customer based on a known business profile.

observedTime.description: The time represented by this observation.

v1ProspectScanEvidence.description:
A source observation collected while producing prospect scan results.

Each item describes one source-specific observation rather than another copy
of the summarized results. For example, search evidence contains the query
and its ordered result rows, while AI evidence contains an answer and its
citations.

v1ProspectScanState.description:
The lifecycle state of a prospect scan.

 - PROSPECT_SCAN_STATE_PENDING: The request has been accepted and is waiting to run.
 - PROSPECT_SCAN_STATE_RUNNING: Collection or analysis is in progress.
 - PROSPECT_SCAN_STATE_SUCCEEDED: Results and evidence are available.
 - PROSPECT_SCAN_STATE_FAILED: The scan failed.

googleBusinessProfileCid.description:
The decimal customer ID (CID) of a known Google Business Profile.

Supply digits only, without a URL, prefix, or surrounding whitespace. No
business name, address, coordinates, category, or keyword is required;
the service resolves those values from the profile.

countryCode.description:
The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code used for the scan. If omitted, the
service uses `US`.

languageCode.description:
The two-letter ISO 639-1 language code used for profile and search results.
If omitted, the service uses `en`.

v1ProspectScanTarget.description:
Selects the business that a prospect scan assesses.

The initial API accepts a Google Business Profile. Additional target types may
be supported in the future, so clients should tolerate variants they do not
recognize. Exactly one target must be set.

businessName.description: The business name observed at this rank.

v1RankedBusiness.description: A business name observed at a particular rank.

v1SearchEngine.description:
Search surfaces supported by prospect scans.

 - SEARCH_ENGINE_GOOGLE: Google Search local or map results.

keyword.description: The keyword used for the search.

results.description: Search results ordered by rank ascending.

v1SearchEvidence.description: Evidence collected from a search result page.

title.description: The title displayed for the result.

displayAddress.description: A short address or location label displayed with the result.

v1SentimentBreakdown.description: Percentages of evaluated answers by sentiment.
